h: Shabbos Makes Every Soul an Ark Within the Mishkan

p: and the table with the bread
I will set in the north."
We have already said several times
is like the Mikdash in the world,
and one must arrange the vessels
and the menorah in the south
who spreads the shelter of peace over us
and over all His people Yisrael
And the Ark alludes to Yisrael;
for the Ark is a vessel
which is like a talmid chacham;
as is learned from the Ark
that his inside must be like his outside
has words of Torah in him,
"'The congregation of Yannai' is not written here,
"'To the house of Yaakov their sins':
these are the amei ha'aretz…" and so on.
That is, even in an am ha'aretz
יֵשׁ בּוֹ גַּם כֵּן דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
there are also words of Torah,
To a Sefer Torah that was burned";
"There is no empty one in Yisrael
who has no Torah and mitzvos in him."
as is written (beginning of Seder Eliyahu Rabbah):
and as is written in the Pesikta,
that what is written in the Yerushalmi
And we said that about this they said
"Are you more important to us than it?"
כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הוּא כְּתַלְמִיד חָכָם
every one of Yisrael is like a talmid chacham.
And this is what is written in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 20):
that is added to Yisrael on Erev Shabbos
for those who toil in Torah
are like Shabbosos and Yamim Tovim
because they are free only for Torah.
are among those who toil in Torah,
and then all Yisrael resemble the Ark.

And they said in the Gemara there (Berachos 55a):

only to one who has wisdom,
He gives wisdom to the wise…" and so on.
Now this needs to be understood:
"Behold, the fear of Hashem is wisdom";
and fear of Heaven comes from the side of man,
"What does Hashem your God ask of you
as is written in the Gemara (Berachos 33b).

all wisdom and all the Torah
and does the words of Torah,
all wisdom and all the Torah

And this is the meaning of
"and in the heart of every wise-hearted one":
that is, one who has fear of Heaven,
about those who occupy themselves with Torah
and have no fear of Heaven.

and the question did not apply,

who was mentioned with the Ark.

he ought to have called first the wise-hearted
And from this they learned in the Gemara
that Moshe went and reversed it
"Make an Ark and vessels and a Mishkan";
that is, that Betzalel should first make the vessels
before the wise-hearted made the Mishkan.
that Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, changed it
that Betzalel too would be able
to make the Ark and the vessels
עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
by Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
that he was the good provider
who could bring in the Torah she'b'al peh
by the power of the special virtue of the Written Torah,
a halachah of Moshe from his own reasoning,
וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן הוּא מִסִּינַי
and nevertheless it is from Sinai,
for it was clear to him
that they were the words of Hashem
And this is from what is written (Shemos 35:31):
"And He filled him with the spirit of God,
with wisdom, with understanding and with knowledge";
and it is stated in the Gemara (Berachos there, 55a):

to bring in the Torah she'b'al peh
